goal: Warn developers at compile time when non-owning views bind to temporary containers
Prevents accidental dangling memory bugs before code reaches runtime
agreement: Blocked by an unaddressed objection that dangling views still go undiagnosed (maflcko)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because compile-time checks on utility helpers prevent subtle dangling pointer bugs
Improves internal safety across the codebase but is reasonably deferrable
